title: Shifted-ball comparison: two ball integrals differ by at most K times the measure of an annulus
statement: Let n ≥ 1, x, w ∈ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), and ρ, K ∈ ℝ with ‖w‖ ≤ ρ and K ≥ 0. Let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on B̆_{ρ+‖w‖}(x) with |u(z)| ≤ K for all z ∈ B̆_{ρ+‖w‖}(x). Let ω := Lⁿ(B̆_1(0)) as a real number. Then |∫_{B̆_ρ(x+w)} u − ∫_{B̆_ρ(x)} u| ≤ K·ω·((ρ + ‖w‖)ⁿ − (ρ − ‖w‖)ⁿ). In Lean the first integral must be parenthesized; otherwise the set-integral notation absorbs `- ∫ …` into its integrand.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (x w : Euclid n) (ρ K : ℝ), 0 < n → ‖w‖ ≤ ρ → 0 ≤ K → IntegrableOn u (ball x (ρ + ‖w‖)) → (∀ z ∈ ball x (ρ + ‖w‖), |u z| ≤ K) → |(∫ y in ball (x + w) ρ, u y) - ∫ y in ball x ρ, u y| ≤ K * (volume (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1)).toReal * ((ρ + ‖w‖) ^ n - (ρ - ‖w‖) ^ n)
